rules: not operationalisable: an enumeration of prop-firm account mechanics (static; trailing end-of-day; trailing unrealised; daily-loss-limit plus trailing maximum-loss-limit), i.e. definitions of how a firm computes a breach floor. It makes no claim about XAUUSD price: every rule is true by the firm's contract, and its only 'measurable' (breach probability of one trade sequence under each type) is a Monte Carlo property of a given strategy's P&L path under firm-specific terms, not something a trade/gate/rate test on gold OHLC can confirm or refute. The one decidable-looking statement ('identical realised P&L can pass EOD-trailing and fail unrealised-trailing') holds by construction whenever MAE differs.
